rationale: Shirley is building AI productivity tools and web applications with TypeScript/React expertise while currently researching at CMU, and Charlie is deeply conviction-driven on AI expanding who can build software—positioning Expo as the default platform for this next wave of builders. Charlie's experience scaling developer tools (React Native to 3M+ developers) and mentoring founders on mobile development could offer valuable perspective on productizing AI-assisted development, while Shirley's hands-on experience as both a researcher and PM at Zoom bridges the gap between cutting-edge ML and real shipping constraints.
intro_message: Shirley Li, meet Charlie Cheever — you're both operating at the intersection of AI democratizing software development and modern web/mobile tooling, and Charlie's lessons building Expo for millions of developers could be directly relevant to how Shirley thinks about shipping AI productivity tools.
